title: Mic North - TIGT (Feat. Cisha)
htmlContent:
Mic North delivers a global smash on the new song “TIGT” featuring Cisha. The record is truly a masterpiece with a driving exciting sound, that stands out from the plethora of new releases in a real way. The vibrant energy in Mic’s vocals it’s one of this records best attributes, with an infectious tone packed with appeal to make you feel the music, as well as make it a record that is set to go to the stars. This exciting sound is match with equally exciting visuals to make you buy into the artistry that they blesses us with to the fullest.
